title: Wednesday's 4 big stock moves: #1 FIS -24% #shorts
description: FIS fell 23.7% on Wednesday after cutting its 2026 profit growth forecast. Here are four big stock moves from Wednesday, counted down.

sources.title: StockTitan, Stock Market Today, Nov 4 2026 (closing and after-hours moves)
FIS Q3 2026 results, SEC Form 8-K exhibit
CVS Tumbles 12% on Plan to Split Into Two Companies (24/7 Wall St.)
Datadog Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

beats.say: FIS fell almost twenty four percent on Wednesday. Four big moves, counted down. Only one went up.

visual.label: Wednesday close: FIS
visual.question: FIS led four big moves. Only one went up.

beats.say: Number four. CVS fell twelve point five percent after announcing a plan to split into two companies.

visual.reason: Plans to split into two companies

beats.say: Number three. Datadog fell about fourteen percent. Revenue grew thirty five percent, but it expects about the same revenue next quarter.

visual.reason: Revenue +35%, but next quarter looks flat

beats.say: Number two. AppLovin jumped nearly twenty three percent after hours, as revenue rose fifty five percent.
And number one, FIS. It fell after cutting its profit growth forecast for this year.

visual.reason: Cut its profit growth forecast for the year

beats.say: Three of these four moves followed what companies said about the future. And that's why

visual.big: Three of these four moves were about the future.
